learningObjective: Distinguish correct claims about disaggregated prefill/decode serving from common overclaims.
stem: Select all correct statements about disaggregated prefill/decode serving. (Choose all that apply.)

options.text: Disaggregation eliminates the need for KV cache entirely because prefill's KV is only consumed by decode via the transfer, so both pools can operate stateless.
Disaggregation improves TPOT under mixed load compared to co-located serving because decode nodes are shielded from long prefills interrupting the decode-step cadence.
Disaggregation reduces total GPU count for a given SLA because each phase's pool can be sized smaller than the combined co-located pool needed to satisfy both metrics simultaneously.

Disaggregation adds a per-request KV cache transfer between prefill and decode pools; this transfer cost sets a floor on TTFT that co-located serving does not have. High-bandwidth interconnects (NVLink Switch, InfiniBand RDMA) are needed to keep this cost small.

explanation: B is correct: shielding decode from prefill contention is the primary TPOT benefit of disaggregation. D is correct: the KV transfer is a real overhead added by disaggregation; high-bandwidth interconnects are needed. A is wrong: KV cache is still needed on decode nodes; it is just transferred instead of created locally. C is wrong: total GPU count is not universally reduced; disaggregation improves phase-scheduling flexibility but does not fundamentally lower compute demand.

optionExplanations.D: Correct: transfer overhead is a real new cost.
optionExplanations.A: Wrong: KV still needed on decode side.
optionExplanations.C: Wrong: disaggregation does not reduce total compute; may increase it slightly.

assumptions: Disaggregation refers to physically separate prefill and decode GPU pools.
KV transfer uses zero-copy RDMA over InfiniBand or NVLink.
nonImplications: Does not imply disaggregation is always the right architecture; small clusters may not benefit.
Does not imply that co-located serving cannot mitigate prefill-decode interference (chunked prefill helps too).

distractorRationales.A: Denies KV cache on decode side.
